$description: PieChart (platform/charts/PieChart.jsx, library wave 9, lane B): its component tokens. Slices take the frame's mark color (their data-viz step); these part the slices and set the center value and label. No new color: existing roles.

pie-chart-slice-outline-color.$description: Pie chart: the line between two slices, in the chart's surface color (the small gap between slices).

pie-chart-slice-outline-width.$description: Pie chart: the width of the line between two slices.

pie-chart-center-value-text.$description: Pie chart (donut, half): the center value.

pie-chart-center-value-font-family.$description: Pie chart (donut, half): the center value is a technical value: the data font (Reddit Mono).

pie-chart-center-value-font-size.$description: Pie chart (donut, half): the center value's size.

pie-chart-center-value-font-weight.$description: Pie chart (donut, half): the center value's weight.

pie-chart-center-label-text.$description: Pie chart (donut, half): the words under the center value.

pie-chart-center-label-font-family.$description: Pie chart (donut, half): the center label is UI text: the label font.

pie-chart-center-label-font-size.$description: Pie chart (donut, half): the center label's size.

pie-chart-center-label-line-height.$description: Pie chart (half): the center label's line, the distance the value sits above it.
